notes.title: Trading Cards Now Available!
notes.notes:
Bik now has trading cards, badges, emoticons, and backgrounds!
Community avatars are also now available.

Point and click your way to a complete collection!

Thanks so much for playing!

notes.title: Now available on steam! 25% off for a week!
notes.notes:
At long last, Bik is available on steam!  For a week (until oct 21) get Bik at 25% off. 

You can also now listen to the entire soundtrack in the new juke box which can be reached in the menu in game.  

If you purchased Bik on our website you can get a key through your humble store account.  If you purchased through the groupees bundle, your key should be available soon.

Thanks everyone, I hope you enjoy!
